label: First copy step after <DEL> (re-input of first token) in length-9 sequences, first token z/1/2/w/t
explanation: Very sparse thresholded reset-gate unit, active only in the copy phase. About 89% of activation mass falls at step t = L+1 (recall_idx 1, previous input <DEL>, the fed-back first original token is the input) and about 95% in L = 9 sequences (a few in L = 8). It is strongly token-selective for the first token: z (16x lift, about 54% of mass, and nearly all the top activations), then the digits 1 and 2 (about 5x), then w and t. It never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or for L <= 7. A small tail fires late in the copy phase (recall_idx 6-8) on repeated tokens. Precision is low (about 11%): most L=9 sequences with z/1/2/w/t first do not cross threshold. Having w or u around original positions 3-4 helps somewhat (precision 35%) but does not explain it fully. Magnitude is highest for first token z.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=z (+5.63), phase=2 & in_tok=2 (+3.59), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=1 (+2.84), orig4=w (+2.59), phase=2 & in_tok=t (+2.12), orig3=w (+2.08). Lower it: orig8=- (-2.43), orig7=- (-2.38), orig5=p (-1.81), to_go=4 (-1.79).
